lines.1: Then an incident happened at our middle school.
lines.2: A girl in our class with a lot of problems at home finally joined the delinquent crowd.
lines.3: She showed up at school with her hair dyed purple.
lines.4: Everyone whispered about her from a distance.
lines.5: But Justice Konoe was never going to ignore that.
lines.7: The delinquents, delighted to have another member, jumped to her defense.
lines.8: 「Quit sticking your nose into everything we do! Your constant nagging is annoying as hell!」
lines.9: 「You think I enjoy butting into your business!? I am warning you because you are obviously in the wrong! That is simple common sense!」
lines.11: 「You! Shut up with that common-sense crap already!」
lines.12: At school, Konoe was especially disliked by people like them because she was always on their case.
lines.13: This incident finally made all that resentment explode.
lines.14: After school that day, I heard that the delinquent group had dragged Konoe away by force in the hallway.
lines.15: A girl from our class who had seen it was panicking, saying this might be bad.
lines.17: I had a feeling this could turn into something serious.
lines.18: Apparently there were boys among the people who had taken Konoe.
lines.19: Worst case, she could end up getting beaten while unable to fight back.
lines.20: I let the adrenaline take over and went looking for her.
lines.21: Before I knew it, Subaru was with me.
lines.23: 「They are probably on the roof where they always hang out.」
lines.25: And what I found there was--
lines.26: Several boys were holding Konoe down.
lines.27: Their apparent leader was a blonde girl. Normally she was easy enough to get along with, but when she lost her temper, there was no telling what she would do. She was straddling Konoe.
lines.28: And in her hand... was that a utility knife?
lines.29: 「Hey, hey. What are you doing? This is not funny.」
lines.31: 「Tsushima! Date! She pisses you off too, does she not!?」
lines.32: 「Always mouthing off, always lecturing us... I am sick of people like her!」
lines.33: 「I told her I would scar that smug face of hers, and she told me to try it!」
lines.34: 「Hmph... Cowards who cannot do anything unless you have a whole crowd behind you!」
lines.36: 「I memorized every one of your faces. I am not going to keep quiet about this! If you are going to do something, then do it!」
lines.38: 「You think raising your voice is enough to scare me!? Do not underestimate me!!!!!」
lines.39: Konoe's force of will was incredible.
lines.40: Even pinned down by violence, her spirit refused to break.
lines.43: The enraged blonde girl started sliding out the utility-knife blade with a click.
lines.46: 「Screw that! A whole mob surrounding one person pisses me off!」
lines.47: There was clearly no room left for discussion.
lines.48: Fine. Then I would let this anger carry me.
lines.50: I charged in to stop them.
lines.52: In the end, I took down three and Subaru took down five. We won.
lines.53: That was Subaru for you. A man I could trust to watch my back.
lines.54: It was the first time I had fought people from my own school.
lines.55: Fortunately, Konoe got away with nothing worse than abrasions from being pinned down.
lines.56: Of course, the teachers tore us apart afterward. We only barely escaped suspension.
lines.57: Even so, I felt completely clear-headed.
lines.58: I was happy in a way that made me feel like some hero who had rescued a girl from a gang of villains.
